address: Villa Belrose, boulevard des Crêtes, Gassin, 83580, France
bio: The exclusive, clubby Belrose overlooking the entire Gulf of St Tropez provides the perfect foil for a gourmet Mediterranean feast steeped in flavour and orchestrated by chef Jimmy Coutel. Examples: roast crayfish in seaweed butter, baby broad beans laced in lemon and charred leeks; roast seabass flanked by steamed morels, green peas and Colonnata bacon....
